stories.title: Magic Number = 1 — Playoff Clinch Watch
stories.angle: Cubs are 87-69 with a magic number of 1 entering the off day. One more win (or one Diamondbacks loss) clinches back-to-back playoff trips.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
87-69. Magic number: 1.

The Cubs are one win — or one Diamondbacks loss — from clinching back-to-back playoff trips. 6 games left. October is right there.

stories.title: PCA 40-40 Watch — 45 HR / 38 SB
stories.angle: PCA is at 45 HR and 38 SB — two steals from joining only 6 players ever in the 40-40 club. No Cub has ever done it. Six games remain.

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
45 HR. 38 SB. Two steals from Cubs history.

PCA needs just 2 more stolen bases to join the 40-40 club — a feat only 6 players in MLB history have ever pulled off. Six games remain.

stories.title: Swanson Returns + HR — October Ready
stories.angle: Swanson returned Sept 18 after 33 days on IL, then hit a home run Sept 19 (first HR since Aug 12). A clean bill of health heading into October.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
2 hits, 1 HR in his second game back — Dansby Swanson looks like the October shortstop the Cubs need.

Out 33 days with an oblique strain. Back Sept. 18. Already homering.

stories.title: Justin Steele Bullpen Decision Looms
stories.angle: Iowa season ended Sept 20. Steele's final rehab appearance: 2 IP, 0 ER, 5 K. Decision meeting with Cubs on Sept 22. Multi-inning LHP reliever for October is the expected path.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
2 scoreless innings, 5 strikeouts in his final Iowa start — Justin Steele meets with the Cubs on Tuesday.

The question isn't if he pitches in October. It's how many innings they trust him with.

stories.title: WC1 Tiebreaker — 6-1 vs Phillies = Wrigley Series
stories.angle: Cubs went 6-1 vs Philadelphia this season — they own the WC1 tiebreaker outright. Hosting the Wild Card Series at Wrigley means every game in front of home fans.

x_posts.text:
6-1 vs. the Phillies this season — the Cubs own the WC1 tiebreaker outright.
